subject: general
question: The ‘Animal Welfare Board of India’ established in the year 1962, under Section 4 of the ‘Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960’, is a statutory advisory body, formed for advising the Government of India, on animal welfare laws, falls under which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of environment and forest and climate change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of environment and forest and climate change**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Animal Welfare Board of India **was founded in** 1962** under Section 4 of the Animal Cruelty Prevention Act of 1960.
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale, a well-known humanitarian, was essential in the formation of the board and served as its first chair.
 
• The Board is made up of 28 members who serve for three years.
 
• Its headquarters were previously located in **Chennai**, but in early 2018, it relocated to Ballabhgarh in the Faridabad region of **Haryana**.
 
• Originally, the board was under the Ministry of Food and Agriculture of the Indian government.
 
• The issue of Animal Cruelty Prevention was transferred to the Ministry of Environment, Forests, and Climate Change in 1990, and it presently resides there. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
